algorithm.name: Loss Quality
algorithm.description: Measures how competitive losses were against opposition strength. Combines opponent difficulty (1 - expected_score) with game closeness ratio.
algorithm.limitations: Where set/game scores are missing, measures opposition strength without claiming game closeness.

parameters.multiplier: 0.5 + 0.5 * closeness_factor when score present; 1.0 when score missing
parameters.displayedScore: Average Loss Quality per loss (distinguishes efficiency from loss volume)
